interpretation: Counts are failed GitHub Actions workflow runs, not counts of unique defects. Several runs repeat the same failure while commits were iteratively corrected. Representative diagnostics were inspected for each cluster; the failure ledger records distinct root causes and closure evidence.

feature/adversarial-gauntlet-expansion.representative_finding: Evidence-format expectations changed during the initial adversarial evidence-bundle rollout; representative failure reported unsupported evidence format.

feature/attested-run-metadata.representative_finding: Run metadata became mandatory while older test fixtures still omitted agent/model/adapter metadata. Root cause and correction are recorded in failure ledger FG-001.

feature/multi-turn-session-protocol.representative_finding: JSONL input used a literal escaped delimiter instead of physical line breaks. Root cause and correction are recorded in FG-006.

feat/deterministic-semantic-assertions.representative_finding: Tests imported gauntlet.assertions before the module landed on the branch; collection failed with ModuleNotFoundError.

feat/commit-40-challenge-pack-engine.representative_finding: Pack manifests were incrementally brought into the required assertions and permission schema; discovery tests initially included a legacy non-pack challenge.

feat/commit-41-tool-loop-v1.representative_finding: Challenge permission fixtures and tests were out of sync after the per-pack tools allowlist was added.

feat/commit-42-openssh-attestation.representative_finding: Literal escaped newline sequences were written into Python source during edits, causing SyntaxError during test collection.

feat/commit-44-gri-leaderboard-gate.representative_finding: Successive schema and admission changes exposed incomplete provenance fixtures, outdated GRI expected values, incomplete evidence/seed inventories, and changing empty-board semantics.

fix/signed-scorecard-claims-binding.representative_finding: The new signed-claims digest required updates to scorecard fixtures and allowed_signers test files; early tests also had newline and assertion mismatches. Final correction is recorded in FG-007.

fix/tool-loop-containment-parity.representative_finding: A literal escaped newline in a multi-line import caused SyntaxError across the matrix. Root cause and correction are recorded in FG-009.

fix/tool-loop-observed-retries.representative_finding: Legacy tests still expected the previous one-call, caller-declared retry behavior after the stateful fixture-controlled retry model was introduced. Correction is recorded in FG-010.
